data.one_liner: A lightweight Dart scripting language for embedding in Flutter apps
data.what_it_does: Hetu Script lets you write and execute scripts at runtime, exposing JavaScript‑friendly APIs and allowing Dart functions to be called from script and vice versa.
use_when: You need hot‑fix or runtime scripting in a Flutter app
You want to expose Dart logic to a scriptable UI or game
You prefer a JavaScript‑like syntax for scripting
avoid_when: You need a full‑blown state‑management or dependency‑injection framework
You require extensive third‑party integrations beyond scripting
strengths: Runs on all Flutter platforms, including web and desktop
JavaScript‑friendly standard library makes it easy for JS developers
Easy binding: call Dart functions from script with one line
Supports async/await and modern language features
weaknesses: No built‑in state‑management or UI widgets
Limited ecosystem compared to mainstream packages
Requires manual setup of bindings for Dart functions
Documentation is primarily in English, Chinese available
data.setup_notes: Add dependency, create Hetu instance, call init(), then eval() or use externalFunctions map
